open_findings.title: Typed numeric/period/currency constraints are discarded before positive anchor labels

reproductions.expected: No cross-dimension equivalence; unknown/incompatible remains explicit; existing numeric_audit.verify_row rejects ratio-to-amount conversion.
Preserve numeric token sign; -5 is not the numeric literal 5.
Shared year may be a partial anchor only; no full literal_match for an absent H1 token.

reproductions.actual: currency_families returns CNY; unit literal_match and no currency risk
reproductions.expected: No invented CNY from substring 元 in 日元 (or other non-CNY units); retain unsupported currency as unknown, do not demand a new complete currency lexicon.

open_findings.root_cause: The new helper duplicates free-text numeric canonicalization instead of routing declared typed comparisons through the existing numeric checker; sign, ratio-vs-amount and currency evidence are lost. Period matching separately ORs a reduced year into full-period matching. Report-only status avoids a final semantic PASS, but positive anchor observations themselves are inaccurate.
open_findings.required_fix: Keep literal-token observation separate from typed conversion. Reuse numeric_audit owner for comparable declared values; unknown or incompatible quantity/currency stays unknown. Preserve signed numeric tokens. Separate full period literal from partial year token. Remove unconditional bare-元 CNY inference. No new manual gate, second conversion table, company-specific logic or semantic-verdict layer.

open_findings.title: Explicit unread support with retained text still receives positive anchor observations

reproductions.expected: Explicit unavailable/unread material must not provide positive observed support anchors; preserve available metadata/context separately and report not_observed for this claim-support leg.

open_findings.root_cause: Every anchor method treats nonempty text as readable, ignoring explicit reading_state. Existing regression covers unread only when text is empty, so the declared missing-observation condition is never exercised with retained partial/cached text.
open_findings.required_fix: Resolve explicit availability once at the shared observation entry point, and apply consistently to standalone observe_map and prepare_output_packet; preserve role/context metadata and normal missing_fragment_reference diagnostics. Do not require new source reauthorization or add per-material approval. Add unread/partial-text, no-text, read controls and verify no false final success.

notes.text: Producer-side missing claim value/period/subject/unit is disclosed and outside this card; do not silently infer fields or relabel this card as production numeric verification.
